items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1976-02-04
items.q: Bunk Johnson lots of times sat in with Bolden

ctx.x: some people have indicated that he really wanted Louis to stay with him in Chicago when Louis left and went to New York, and that I think Lil Armstrong, his wife, his second wife, sort of had an influence on his leaving the band. Do you think there was any bitterness on Joe's part when Louis left to go to Chicago?

Oh, that's not no bitterness. I don't think there was no, there was no bitterness, but it was a sort of a, a loss to Joe because there was a tradition in New Orleans to have two trumpets in the band. Papa Celestine had two, at one time, Manny Perez had two, first and second trumpet. And, uh, other bands around had two trumpets, and you played second. And it was guys, it's just like baseball, a second string catcher, you dig, more than one pitcher, and, uh, or more than one quarterback in a, a football team. It…
